authorization.scope: Choose an idealized collider preparation with declared energy/packet parameters and no additional incoming radiation; calculate beam-generated, constraint-required and inherited fields.
authorization.parameters_are: new theoretical design choices, not recovered measurements and not fitted BHSM coefficients

process.other_action_coupled_outgoing_channels_a: retain; selecting a readout channel does not set its production probability to one

frame_and_geometry.frame: local collision center-of-momentum tetrad on the same inherited physical background
frame_and_geometry.spatial_axes: right-handed orthonormal X1,X2,X3; central electron moves +X3 and positron -X3
frame_and_geometry.initial_slice_clock: tau=0 in the local preparation frame; this is not the birth clock or the earlier complex terminal cut
frame_and_geometry.nominal_encounter: origin at d/(2 v_e) in the noninteracting narrow-packet reference only; actual event time is solved
frame_and_geometry.embedding_clock_scale_and_constraint_fie: construct from the existing action and calibrated physical-unit map; retain inherited geometry

beam_energy.convention: central on-shell total energy including rest energy, measured in the local collision tetrad
beam_energy.packet_mean_energy: calculate after actual spectral construction; a packet has a spread and its mean need not equal the central-mode energy
beam_energy.action_momentum_binding: solve the actual admissible incoming dispersion/pole relation at the selected energy; the free reference momentum is only a check

packets.envelope: isotropic Gaussian coherent packet for each incoming species
packets.width_convention: 1-sigma of the scalar probability envelope in the local preparation chart, not a particle radius or a rest-frame size
packets.coherence: each momentum packet is coherent; spin sectors are incoherently averaged; incoming species packet coefficients factor before required field dressing
packets.reference_normalization_measure: d^3 k, delta-normalized scalar momentum basis; convert explicitly if using invariant mass-shell measure
packets.reference_centers_k: k_e=(0,0,+sqrt(E_beam^2-m_e^2)); k_p=(0,0,-sqrt(E_beam^2-m_e^2)) in natural energy units
packets.physical_realization: map the declared Gaussian into the action's physical particle/antiparticle mode spaces and gauge-covariant spin frames; use the full physical Cauchy Gram
packets.physical_normalization: one physical incoming particle per species; do not replace the full Cauchy Gram with pointwise or Euclidean norm
packets.projection_scope: report achieved centroids, energy/spread, RMS widths and projection error; do not relabel a free envelope as a solved full18 BHSM section
packets.numerical_refinement: hold this preparation fixed while refining numerical basis/quadrature; distinguish physical parameter variations from discretization

spin_state.outgoing_spin: retain full muon spin density/matrices until the magnetic coefficient has been extracted

incoming_environment.reference: retain the current branch's same-action inherited reference geometry/field/sea state; do not replace it by globally empty Minkowski space
incoming_environment.additional_incoming_radiative_state: no independently injected coherent radiation and no extra thermal/squeezed/particle occupation over that reference; retain vacuum fluctuations and required charge dressing
incoming_environment.external_machine_fields_in_local_interac: no additional externally imposed electric or magnetic field during production
incoming_environment.longitudinal_and_near_fields: solve the Gauss/constraint-consistent fields of the specified incoming packets, with their inherited couplings and temporal conormals
incoming_environment.metric_Higgs_and_other_constraint_fields: solve on the same background with the same packet sources; not independently zeroed
incoming_environment.preparation_prescription: use the existing admissible incoming dressed/scattering construction with no independent incoming homogeneous radiation; evaluate its induced Cauchy data on the chosen preparation slice
incoming_environment.reference_dependency_rule: if the inherited quantum reference itself is not instantiated, identify its exact remaining action/state selector and proceed with existing definitions; do not request an experimental wavefunction file or invent a primordial population
incoming_environment.outgoing_domain: existing action-defined retarded/outgoing domain and coupled channels; no artificial reflecting cap or dropped physical delayed response

calibration_and_units.policy: use already-authorized independent calibration consistently; do not overwrite existing action relations or retune fixed Yukawas

electron_mass_energy_MeV.role_in_package: CODATA 2022 reference kinematics only; not a supplied action pole

muon_mass_energy_MeV.role_in_package: CODATA 2022 reference threshold check only; not a BHSM prediction

calibration_and_units.action_unit_conversion: existing physically matched common unit; never set the chart unit equal to the beam energy by convention
calibration_and_units.target_anomaly_and_magnetic_moment_const: not included in this input package

magnetic_probe.readout: separate weak measuring-field derivative on the formed muon, then the charge-normalized soft Pauli limit
magnetic_probe.probe_limit: B -> 0; use the owned weak source and its soft/domain limits, not a specified finite accelerator magnet
magnetic_probe.target: a_mu=F2(0); g_mu=2*(1+a_mu), when the physical decomposition and normalization hold
magnetic_probe.possible_preparation_dependence: preserve and report; establish an isolated-state limit before calling a state-dependent response a universal anomaly

later_sensitivity_controls_not_baseline_.order: finish one baseline physical connection before starting the scan
later_sensitivity_controls_not_baseline_.rule: one change at a time; do not choose the favorable run by agreement with measured a_mu; preserve all action-coupled channels

additional_actions: connected chronological K_ZZ^R and K_EZ terminal return
same-domain physical pole/residue and magnetic readout
implementation_entry_points.two_trace_boundary_law: src/bhsm/interface/muon_two_collar_weak_domain.py; interacting law only at nonzero surface source
implementation_entry_points.regular_cap_c: q(0), the central U(1) radial Gauss-flux integration constant; not the spectral cutoff

execution_status.scope: input specification plus reference kinematic checks; not an executable physical collider solution
